description.en: Genus-level original fossil-form study of the incomplete classic Ernietta basal sack, informed by primary2017 Fig3e/f/g actual fossil casts/moulds and Ivantsov2016 description of truncation. Not a living whole-organism reconstruction, facsimile, scan or exact named specimen. The2016 interpretation makes clear the classic sack is a buried basal part of a larger organism with trunk and paired fans; these missing parts are deliberately not reconstructed, before modeling. Central cavity exposed by truncation, some sediment infill, and neutral sandstone palette are illustrative preservation choices. Nominal80x50x55mm targets illustrative, not measured specimen; affinity and original living anatomy uncertain.
